title: Result dtype of IntervalIndex set ops with an empty RangeIndex depends on infer_string
answers: why does union with empty index drop interval dtype
expected dtype for symmetric_difference with an empty RangeIndex
body:
In IntervalIndex `union` and `symmetric_difference` with an empty `pd.RangeIndex(0)`, in either operand order, the empty RangeIndex is ignored for the result dtype only when `using_infer_string` is on (GH#60797). In that case the result equals the IntervalIndex. Otherwise the result is `index.astype(object)`.
Tests of set ops against empty non-interval indexes must branch on the `using_infer_string` fixture. See pandas/tests/indexes/interval/test_setops.py:TestIntervalIndex.test_set_op_empty_rangeindex.
applies: Writing or changing tests and behaviour for Index set operations that involve an empty RangeIndex
